business_summary: Relaxo Footwears Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of footwear and related products for men, women, and kids in India and internationally. The company offers casual, running, athleisure, walking, sneakers, formal, sports, school, and training and gym shoes; and slippers, sandals, flip-flops, slides, chappals, and clogs, as well as footwear accessories. The company also provides wind power generation services. The company provides its products under the Relaxo, Bahamas, Flite, Sparx, BOSTON, Mary Jane, Schoolmate, and KidsFun brands. It sells its products through exclusive branded outlets and e-commerce portals. Relaxo Footwears Limited was founded in 1976 and is based in New Delhi, India.
